What Makes a Pathology Lab Reliable? Key Factors to Know

Choosing a reliable pathology lab is important because accurate test results help doctors make the right treatment decisions. Here are the key factors that make a pathology lab trustworthy:
1. Accurate Test Results: A reliable lab adheres to strict quality standards to deliver precise, dependable reports.
2. Qualified Experts: Experienced pathologists and trained technicians play a major role in ensuring correct testing and reporting.
3. Advanced Equipment: Modern diagnostic machines help improve the accuracy and speed of tests.
4. Proper Hygiene and Safety: Clean and well-maintained laboratory facilities reduce the risk of errors and contamination.
5. Timely Reports: A dependable lab delivers reports on time, helping patients and doctors take quick action when needed.

Never visit this Pulse Diagnostic Centre in Borivali west. Their staff lacks basic skills to operate Diagnostic machines and lack basic human courtesy to deal with patients....who themselves are in poor state of mind.They have employed cheap labour, who lack skills in operating complicated machines.In our case, there was no trained nurse but ward boys doing everything by constantly going in and out of Diagnostic rooms....as if they are having a field day or are in a picnic without any sense of seriousness.The procedure was not properly explained to the patient.

The person in the picture is a technician and when he was asked about the precautions or do's and don'ts of the Diagnostic procedure.....he was arrogant and abusive, saying that, it is not his job.
There was no qualified doctor in the centre of diagnosis.
The highest qualified person available was this technician in the photo....who too was rude, arrogant and even abusive.
In another picture, it is mentioned use of tobacco has Rs 500 fine.The ward boy named Shibu, who was attending us was having his mouth full of guthka and was openly talking and doing his job of attending patients and the machines.
Hence, never visit this centre as this is in the interest of other fellow patients.

This fellow was very rude and misbehaves frequently with patients.

featured_reviews.name: Krishita Chavda
featured_reviews.review_text:
The staff sitting at the reception counter on the first floor is extremely rude towards patients. They literally scream and shout at patients when patients ask any questions regarding services such as X-ray, sonography, blood tests, urine tests, or the forms in which details need to be filled. The staff is very ignorant about which tests require fasting.

When I informed them that my doctor had not advised fasting, they still insisted that fasting was required. I then had to call my doctor to confirm the same.

Please improve the quality of your staff and educate them on how to behave properly with patients.

There is zero respect, zero accountability, and no concern for patient experience. Highly disappointing and would not recommend this place to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: VINIT SHAH
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience at Pulse.Never ever Go

The staff is unprofessional, poorly informed, and insensitive—especially toward senior citizens. We were quoted ₹6,000 for a test, but after 10 hours of fasting, we were asked to pay ₹10,000. No prior clarification was given.
They also failed to inform us about the post-lunch test timing in advance and later refused to take a blood sample at 3 PM, saying the collection van comes only once a day—again, not communicated earlier.
This kind of mismanagement and lack of transparency in healthcare is unacceptable. Strongly not recommended.
